question: What merit is obtained by reciting the mantra inside one's own house?
premises: Recitation occurs in the middle of the house
Bathing in the Gaṅgā yields a known merit
The reciter obtains that same fruit
inference: One who recites in the house obtains the merit of bathing in the Gaṅgā.
plain_english: Whoever recites it in the middle of the house obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā.
